mapper.select: SELECT ald.annual_leave_code, ald.leave_start_date, ald.leave_end_date, um.user_name, fn_find_codename('0B',leave_type), dm.dept_name FROM tb_annual_leave_detail ald JOIN tb_annual_leave al ON al.annual_leave_code = ald.annual_leave_code JOIN tb_user_master um ON um.user_id = al.user_id JOIN tb_dept_master dm ON dm.dept_code = um.dept WHERE ald.company_code = #{companyCode} AND SYSDATE <= ald.leave_start_date AND SYSDATE >= ald.leave_end_date
